st_renouveau.name: Clairière du Renouveau
st_renouveau.alt: A sunny spring clearing on a forest trail, with blossom, bluebells and huge old trees, painted in ink and gouache: Monsieur Verbe puts fresh daffodils in a vase and drops the wilted ones, holds a bottle of oil over a bowl instead of butter, cheers a timid lion cub across a log, gives a little mailbox a new roof and fresh paint, cheers 'yay!' at a birthday cake as a white-bearded old man in a green beret, and fixes little wings onto a toy car. The mossy arch on the left leads back to the valley; the yellow, red and blue doors in the tree trunks and the white picket gate lead on.

doors.hint: Through the yellow door in the oak

etirements.name: Passage des Étirements
etirements.alt: A green beech wood on the trail: Monsieur Verbe adds a weight to a little balance scale on a stump, lowers three alphabet blocks on a rope, lifts dumbbells, stretches one arm high with a yawn holding a hand mirror, kneels proudly behind seedlings growing from tiny to tall in a gold beret, and blows on a steaming cake in a green beret. The yellow door in the oak on the left leads back to the clearing.

doors.label: Clairière du Renouveau
doors.hint: Back through the yellow door in the oak

loupes.name: Berge des Loupes
loupes.alt: A mossy forest stream bank with a little footbridge and willows: Monsieur Verbe presses down an overstuffed suitcase lid in a gold beret, shrugs his shoulders, adds an apple to a tall pyramid in a gold beret, heaves twice as hard on a rope to pull a boat in, looks at a ladybird through a big magnifying glass in a green beret, and moves the path's edging stones outward with a spade in a green beret. The red door in the oak on the left leads back to the clearing.

doors.label: Clairière du Renouveau
doors.hint: Back through the red door in the oak

novateurs.name: Clairière des Novateurs
novateurs.alt: An inventor's camp under a canvas awning in a forest clearing: Monsieur Verbe holds his nose beside a growing pile of garbage in a green beret, studies with a pile of books, swaps an old oil lamp for a new one, stands by a machine of cogs under a glowing light bulb, shows off a cart with a big spinning wheel, and sifts fine sugar into a bowl. The blue door in the oak on the left leads back to the clearing.

doors.label: Clairière du Renouveau
doors.hint: Back through the blue door in the oak

renovateurs.name: Sentier des Rénovateurs
renovateurs.alt: A woodland trail beside an old mossy dry-stone wall: Monsieur Verbe paints little flowers on his watering can, mends the crumbling wall with a trowel and new stones, drops bottles into a recycling bin, plants red and white flowers in turn, watches a rain cloud smudge his chalk drawing on a big rock, and frowns at a dull, darkened silver teapot in a green beret. The white picket gate under the roses on the left leads back to the clearing.

doors.label: Clairière du Renouveau
doors.hint: Back through the white picket gate
